title: The joy of Eid al-Fitr
intro: Three blessed days after Ramadan – the joy of having fasted.

learn.html: Eid al-Fitr is three blessed days after the month of Ramadan. It is celebrated on the 1st, 2nd and 3rd of Shawwal, as the joy of having fasted and done our other duties in Ramadan.
On the morning of the first day of Eid we go to the masjid to pray the Eid prayer.
In the days of Eid we do deeds Allah loves, we are happy, we visit relatives, neighbours and friends, and we give each other gifts.

learn.title: In Bosnia
learn.html: In Bosnia and Herzegovina the second day of Eid al-Fitr is marked as the Day of the Martyrs (shuhada). People visit the graveyards and recite Ya-Sin and Al-Fatiha for their loved ones, the martyrs and all Muslims.

learn.title: Eid greetings
learn.html: We greet each other: Bayram sherif mubarak olsun! (May your blessed Eid be blessed!) and answer: Allah razı olsun! (May Allah be pleased with you!). Many Muslims also say Eid mubarak!
